description: Create a new lesgooo plan and get its shareable links. Optionally adds the user as the first participant (returns their participant_token). Only call after the user asked for it.

title.description: Short plan name, e.g. "Weekend at the cabin" (max 120 chars).

your_name.description: Name of the person you act for; adds them as the first participant (max 80 chars).
